findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_site · Public sink: get_pricing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_site · Public sink: get_pricing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_services" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "The three service lines (build, grow, care) and every capability under them, with what each includes, the typical timeline, who works on it and the price band." → after: "The three service lines (build, grow, care) and every capability under them, with what each includes, the typical timeline, who works on it and how it is priced."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
